fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-12-05, farm equipment valued at around Rs. 60,000 was found missing from a premises near Senthil Garden Main Street. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-12-05 at approximately 12:10. The complainant, Durga Raman, provided the contact number 9000000103. Praveen Balan (9000000446) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Karthik Balan (mobile 9000000380) was named as a possible person of interest.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly entered through an unsecured entry point.
fields.Keywords: property theft, valuables, mobile number, witness statement, witness, main street, CCTV, afternoon
